goals.title: Safe laboratory
goals.objective: Implement Stage 0 and prove Gate 0 without changing the production wallpaper.
goals.evidence: Gate 0 closed by combined evidence: disposable-account fixture and live no-op execution, explicit human UNCHANGED confirmation, Yann live same-byte recovery with identical SHA-256/mode/uid/gid/mtime/stable xattrs, known volatile com.apple.provenance isolated, tampered bundle rejected, and no provider selection attempted.

goals.title: Compatibility contract
goals.objective: Implement Stage 1 and close Gate 1 with sanitized evidence.
goals.evidence: Gate 0 passed with current-account recovery. Gate 1 desktop selection passed twice: logs prove runtime image choice delegation; sanitized store diff proves deterministic fallback mutation and repeated idempotence; product contract updated fail-closed. Lock-screen/multi-display remain explicitly deferred to later system lifecycle gates.

goals.title: Extension boundary
goals.evidence: Gate 2 passed on macOS 26.3 arm64: clean Release build embeds an XPC! com.apple.wallpaper ExtensionKit extension, exact OS/build compatibility fails closed, nested ad-hoc signing preserves sandbox entitlement, PluginKit enumerates it from ~/Applications, and install/status/disable/enable/repair/remove/reinstall all passed without wallpaper mutation. Fresh xcodebuild test passed 22 tests (17 core, 5 SPI).

goals.title: Transactional activation
goals.objective: Implement Stage 4 only on the disposable account and prove Gate 4.

goals.title: System release gate
goals.objective: Implement Stage 6 and pass the release gate, including final cleanup and review.
